meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. You asked for this, so go ahead. I have until 4:40.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a trip to the principal; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you got anywhere near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you said only a greeting and offered no evidence or ownership of the process.
What cost ground: Nothing yet, but you gave her the first move, and she used it to ask who decided on the zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because nothing was said about the essay, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: After the greeting, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document in front of her that she can check herself.
